title: Accessibility
description: Tools and practices that help everyone access content on the Office of the Royal Society website

blocks.heading: Accessibility
blocks.lead: Tools and practices that help everyone access content on the Office of the Royal Society website

blocks.html:
Adjust the website to suit your reading

Every page has an “Accessibility” button in the bottom-right corner — or try the tools right here below.

blocks.heading: Using the keyboard
rows: Move to the next link or button (the first press at the top of a page shows “Skip to main content”)
Move back to the previous link or button
Open the selected link or press the selected button
Close the open menu, dialog or panel

blocks.heading: For screen reader users
paragraphs: Images have text alternatives, headings follow the page structure, and links that open in a new tab say so.

blocks.body: [Accessibility conformance level achieved (e.g. WCAG 2.1 / Thai government website standard) — awaiting audit results]

blocks.heading: Report an accessibility problem
blocks.lead: If any part of the website is hard to use, please let the Office know through these channels.

items.title: Contact form
items.body: Tell us the page and the problem; staff will get back to you.

items.title: Email
items.body: Send details or a screenshot of the problem.
